content: {"action":"appeal_with_necessity","reasoning":"The claim was denied for missing prior authorization, and the payer’s retroactive authorization window is closed, so another retro-auth request would violate published rules. Peer-to-peer is unavailable, and resubmission would not correct the authorization defect. A formal appeal supported by medical necessity is the only available action that can properly seek payer reimbursement without improperly billing the patient."}
